_about: External binaries the worker image installs (infra/docker/Dockerfile.worker). Every `go install` there, and every listed apt package, must be listed here (Go entries with the same version) with a permitted licence or a recorded, attributed exception; infra/scripts/tools_manifest_check.py enforces it in CI. ADR-0002: adopt MIT/permissive tools as separate processes, never GPL/AGPL.

tools.name: subfinder
tools.used_for: Passive subdomain discovery (recon). Queries public data sources, sends nothing to the target.

tools.name: httpx
tools.used_for: HTTP probe of in-scope hosts: status, title, server, Wappalyzer-based technology detection.

tools.name: tlsx
tools.used_for: TLS grading (installed; not yet called by a scan).

tools.name: nmap
tools.version: Debian package of the worker base image (the exact version is recorded in every tool run)
tools.used_for: Service and version detection on the ports naabu found open (active; Full recon profile only; needs authorisation)
tools.exception: Approved exception to ADR-0002 (see its Exceptions section). Used only inside the hosted worker, only on the Full profile, only through sentinel_recon/nmap_wrapper.py (swappable), as a separate process, and never distributed or bundled into anything shipped to a client. Scope of the approval: internal use, including our own team testing clients' applications; clients do not log into Sentinel. No legal review was obtained. Re-examine before clients get access to Sentinel or Sentinel is distributed or sold.
